create_align_prompt_right: create an AlignPromptRight instance with a pad_id to right-align variable-length token sequences
create_align_prompt_left: create an AlignPromptLeft instance with a pad_id to left-align variable-length token sequences
prepare_inputs_right_aligned: prepare right-aligned input tensors from a list of token ID lists using AlignPromptRight
prepare_inputs_left_aligned: prepare left-aligned input tensors from a list of token ID lists using AlignPromptLeft
postprocess_left_aligned_inputs: postprocess left-aligned inputs by restoring original non-padded token values from the original tensor
